ITEM 1 | Scrambled yellow eggs, pale-to-golden yellow with soft, fluffy curds and small clumps, moist-looking but holding shape in loose mounds; spread across the center-left of the plate, roughly 40% of plate area, about 1.5 cm thick, sitting beneath the bacon strips | 110
ITEM 2 | Two long strips of cooked bacon, reddish-brown with darker browned edges, glossy with rendered fat sheen, slightly curled and flat, each about 12-13 cm long and 1.5-2 cm wide, lying diagonally across the scrambled eggs | 40
ITEM 3 | One smaller irregular piece of cooked bacon, dark reddish-brown, crisp-looking edges with a glossy sheen, roughly 5 x 4 cm and about 0.5 cm thick, sitting at the lower edge of the plate below the strips | 15
